propositions: The shared verify_findings() outcome_counts tally (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) and contract_violations are not currently wired into both live consumer pipelines (plan_review and code_review) due to workflow engine architecture: per-chunk boundaries are lost after the executor merges outputs.

plan_review_decide calls reshape_verifications() and records contract violations via a run-scoped ContextVar sink (collect_contract_violations/record_contract_violation/drain_contract_violations) into coverage, but code_review_decide performs only the reshape check and logs errors without a sink, so violation data never reaches finalize_code_review_verdict.

The contract-violation sink (currently private to plan_review/orchestrator.py) must be moved into review_kernel and made shared, activated in gate_dispatch._run_code_review_gate for code-review and drained into finalize_code_review_verdict's coverage, mirroring plan-review's behavior.

A shared helper decide_outcome_counts() must derive a whole-run {clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable} tally at the *_decide boundary from available merged data, with unrecoverable always 0 per workflow engine limitations.

Both plan_review_decide and code_review_decide must call the shared decide_outcome_counts() helper and emit outcome_counts in their output dict, threaded into each pipeline's verdict coverage as coverage["outcome_counts"].

Existing test suites must continue passing; new tests must cover code-review's outcome_counts and contract-violation propagation and verify the moved sink works for both pipelines from its new shared location.
